cells.contract: Bound fields track raw/normalized/error/changed state; cleaning order field → custom field clean → form clean.
cells.items: Boolean/NullBoolean, Char, Choice/TypedChoice, MultipleChoice/TypedMultipleChoice, Date/DateTime/Time/Duration, Decimal/Float/Integer, Email, URL, UUID, Slug, IP, Regex, JSON

cells.contract: Choices resolved through actor-scoped querysets; file validation shares storage rules; composite cleaning collects subfield errors.

Disabled fields use trusted initial values; ModelForm readonly exclusions are not bound from POST. Ignore undeclared HTML form fields; validate management and identity inputs explicitly; invalid hidden fields appear in error summary.
cells.items: required, initial, disabled, label/suffix, help_text, widget attrs, error_messages, validators, localize, prefix, auto_id, field_order, renderer, bound_field class

cells.contract: Validation repeatable and cached within bound instance; error labels linked via accessible IDs; default values never mistaken for submitted false/zero.
cells.items: IsBound, IsValid, Errors/ErrorList/ErrorDict, CleanedData, AddError, HasChanged, ChangedData, BoundField; render div/p/table/list/template

cells.contract: Escaped attributes; sensitive password never redisplayed; media assets deduplicated deterministically.
cells.items: Text, Number, Email, URL, Password, Hidden, MultipleHidden, File, ClearableFile, Textarea, Date/DateTime/Time, Checkbox, Select, NullBooleanSelect, SelectMultiple, Radio, CheckboxMultiple

cells.contract: Widget renders UI only; field retains validation authority; custom widget assets declared, not arbitrary inline scripts.
cells.items: MultiWidget, SplitDateTime, SplitHiddenDateTime, SelectDate; decompression/compression; template renderer; JS/CSS Media

cells.contract: Explicit writable allowlist; commit=false returns unsaved instance with deferred relation plan; save parent before SaveM2M.
cells.items: Factory, include/exclude, ModelFormSet, InlineFormSet, field/form callbacks, commit=false, SaveM2M, unique/constraint validation

cells.contract: Reject forged management counts; absolute maximum bound before allocating forms; duplicate object IDs rejected; all writes one transaction.
cells.items: Management form, prefix, initial/extra/min/max/absolute_max, ordering, deletion, empty_form, custom clean, nonform errors, model/inline factories
